summary: Designed and implemented the ntuple-scale approach (approaches/ntuple-rl/ntuple-scale): pattern indexing straight from the Rust engine's packed column words, the lookup-table model with temporal-coherence TD updates, the one-ply chance-state training policy, the game harness, and the train/gate/screen binaries; registered the theory, experiment and seed leases; ran the CHECK gates, the pilot configuration arms, the main training run and the one-shot screen; wrote the result record, the approach page, the web progress figures and the research-log entry.
validationPerformed: gate binary: 15 CHECK gates on the probe block, all PASS (gates.log)
make research-validate (no errors on this experiment's records; 23 pre-existing errors concern other contributors' missing runs/ artifacts)
node web/scripts/check-mdx.mjs, node scripts/check-approach-frontmatter.mjs, node web/scripts/check-figures.mjs, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, npm run build under web/
analyze.py evaluated the preregistered gate from the screen artifact; compare.py reports written for five contrasts
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.

The direction was chosen by the repository owner from a ranked list the model produced earlier the same day; the owner set the branch, the Rust and column-packing requirements and the reporting cadence.
